exposure: Procalcitonin (PCT) level after rewarming (<2.5 ng/ml vs. >=2.5 ng/ml)
cohort: Newborns with moderate/severe HIE treated with therapeutic hypothermia
finding: In neonates with HIE treated with therapeutic hypothermia, high post-rewarming procalcitonin levels were associated with severe HIE and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: High post-rewarming procalcitonin levels were associated with cesarean delivery.
